data.action: 蹲在码头石阶双手捧起发光金色海灯，眼眸闪亮
data.animaCaption: Crouching on the stone steps of a lantern-lit harbor at night, she cradles a glowing golden paper lantern in both hands with a joyful smile as hundreds of lights drift across the sea behind her.
data.camera: 中近景，平视，海面灯火虚化背景
data.description: 海灯节夜晚的拉古那白石码头边，成千上万盏金色莲花水灯随海浪漂远，菲比身着白蓝水手领巡游裙蹲在石阶上双手捧灯许愿。
data.lighting: 海灯暖金火光映照脸庞与海面星灯
data.location: 拉古那海灯节白石码头
data.promptProse: Kneeling on the seaside stone steps during Ragunna's lantern festival, Phoebe holds a warm glowing paper lantern in both palms, wearing a nautical white-and-cerulean pleated sailor dress.
data.title: 菲比 · 拉古那海灯节码头放飞水灯
